title: Make Codex chat submit deterministic with an Insert separator
body:
Bug: chat posts injected into a Codex pane sometimes stay in the composer as "[Pasted Content N chars]" and never submit; later posts stack into the same placeholder. The 500ms SUBMIT_DELAY (src/ready.rs, commit 43c3b13) only changes the odds. Do NOT fix with a delay or timer.

Root cause (verified in Codex 0.163.0 source, tag rust-v0.163.0):
- On Windows Codex clears ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_INPUT, so conhost drops our ESC[200~/ESC[201~ markers and delivers the paste as individual key records.
- Codex's PasteBurst heuristic (codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/paste_burst.rs) guesses paste boundaries by HANDLING time. An Enter handled within 60ms of the last pasted char (or the 120ms PASTE_ENTER_SUPPRESS_WINDOW) becomes a newline (chat_composer/reconnect.rs handle_paste_enter). When Codex's loop falls behind it handles paste tail and our \r back to back, so wire timing is irrelevant.
- Any non-char, non-Enter key reaching ChatComposer::handle_input_basic_with_time runs flush_before_modified_input -> apply_paste (clear_after_explicit_paste) and clear_window_after_non_char. A following Enter then submits.

Fix: for Codex panes only, make the deferred submit write ESC[2~ (plain Insert) followed by \r as ONE write, replacing the bare \r. Codex handles keys FIFO, so the order paste -> Insert -> Enter holds no matter how far behind it is.
- Why Insert: users cannot bind it (codex config/src/tui_keymap.rs normalize_key_name and keymap.rs parse_keybinding have no "insert"; chords use the same parser). Its only default use is vim_normal.enter_insert. Plain Insert is a no-op in the non-vim textarea, list/approval/request_user_input views, pager and transcript. Shift+Insert (paste) and Ctrl+Insert (copy) are not triggered. F12 was rejected because users can bind it.
- Never append ESC[2~ to the paste write: ConPTY's end-of-run heuristic (sm.cpp ProcessString) turns a split trailing ESC into an Esc key (interrupts Codex).
- Claude Code and other agents keep today's bytes unchanged (Claude reads real paste markers).
- Codex detection: use the check added by the sibling card "Fix Codex pane detection when the prompt mentions claude" (do that card first).

Do (bug-fix order is mandatory):
1. Witness a failing regression on unchanged code: extend the ignored real-Codex test codex_chat_submit_while_busy in src/terminal.rs (or add a sibling) that writes paste + \r back to back with no delay into the installed Codex; assert the post stays unsubmitted. Then show it submits with the Insert separator.
2. Add a deterministic unit test in src/ready.rs for the Codex submit bytes (ESC[2~\r in one Action::Write) vs the unchanged non-Codex \r.
3. Implement. Keep SUBMIT_DELAY as is; removing it for Codex is a separate decision once the regression proves ordering holds.
4. Update docs/chat-delivery.md ("One post = one turn" gotcha) and the SUBMIT_DELAY doc comment.

Gates: cargo fmt --check; cargo test --target-dir target/agent; the ignored real-Codex test run alone: cargo test codex_chat_submit -- --ignored --nocapture. Report its before/after output.
Related: ISSUES.md open entry on swallowed chat pastes.
